people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.
translations.bsb: From the half-tribe of Manasseh: 18,000 designated by name to come and make David king.
translations.kjv: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.
translations.asv: And of the half-tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.
